sectionOne.heading: Think critically.
body: The words are the Principal's. She describes a Sunbeam education as *“nurturing character, inspiring creativity”*, and the student it is meant to produce as one who **“thinks critically, acts responsibly, and dreams fearlessly.”**

Beyond knowing the answer is a teachable thing, so the school treated it as one: it brought in a workshop on **teaching critical thinking in the classroom** and put its own staff through it. The training went to the teachers first.

sectionTwo.heading: A position you
body: Sunbeam's students went to **CMSMUN** — which the school records as *“an experience that went beyond the classroom.”* A Model United Nations committee is the one room where a thought is no use until it has been said out loud, to people who may disagree.
The school keeps a **Model United Nations Lab** among its inquiry rooms, so the committee is not only something the delegation meets once a year at somebody else's conference.

sectionThree.heading: Two days, seven schools,
body: **SUNBEAM INNOVX — Hackathon & Coding Contest 2026** is the school's own description of *“a two-day celebration of young innovators solving real-world problems through code, creativity, and collaboration.”*
Seven schools entered the preliminary round. The finals took the top three on cut-off merit — {schoolName}, Columbus International School and PM Shri Kendriya Vidyalaya.
sectionThree.imageOneAlt: A student of {schoolName} beside the Monash University Innovation Guarantee banner at an outreach session

sectionFour.heading: Create.
body: Because ideas become powerful when students have the freedom to express them — on a stage, in a presentation, or with their hands. The school's own TED Talk put it best: *“Where ideas take the stage and voices find their power.”*
